This fungus is found chiefly in cool temperate climates, especially in underground environments, and is best known throughout Endor. Even in suitable terrain, it remains of medium difficulty to find.

Flameroot is an underground fungus prepared as a decoction. It does not immediately restore a fixed number of concussion hits; instead, it doubles the natural recovery rate. It is therefore better suited to rest and convalescence than to emergency treatment in combat.
